title: Baby Dodds and the Imperial method
summary: Russell compares notes about Baby Dodds, who also used the Imperial method; Francis recalls Dodds on the riverboat with Fate Marable.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: A friend of mine who is dead now from Chicago, I knew him out of Chicago, Baby Dodds, you came from here. I know Baby Dodds. And he started with the imperial method too.
I know Baby Dodds, I know when he left him. I was playing Tom Ashton, he was playing on the captain with Fate and Marble.
Oh, that's right, Johnny. He worked on the boat.
See, Lloyd was playing with him, but Lloyd left Fate, come with us. Yeah, came with you. Yeah.

Anyway, Baby said he liked that method real well. He lost his copy though. He said there were a lot of nice pictures. Yeah. Show just how to hold this stick. Yeah, I got the, yeah. And all that. I never did see a copy of that book. I still hope I'll find one.
I don't need to use them no more.
No, I guess not. I don't think it's published anymore. I tried to buy it and I couldn't.
Well, I tried. I bought my last book to teach my grandkid at, he know me good. You know Peterson? Yes. He knew me well. Yeah, Peterson. Broad Street.
